result.markdown:
For most small teams, I'd recommend **HubSpot or Pipedrive**\. They offer the best balance of ease of use, functionality and room to grow without the complexity of enterprise systems.

However, the best choice depends on whether you're primarily managing sales, marketing, customer relationships or all three.

## My top 5 CRM recommendations

**1\. HubSpot CRM**

(Best overall)

- Excellent free starting plan.
- Contact management, deals and sales pipeline.
- Email tracking and marketing integrations.
- Easy for non-technical teams.

**Best for\:** Small businesses wanting sales and marketing together.

[HubSpot website](https://www.hubspot.com/products/crm)

- Simple to learn and implement.

[Zoho website](https://www.zoho.com/crm/)

- Custom workflows.
